apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.3 — Waveform touch, the gate design: the song detail's scroll view now sits in a thin container whose hit test declines touches over the waveform strip while the page rests at the top, so they fall through to the waveform's own Follow, Fit, badge, tap-seek and pinch. The forwarding layer (v1.4.5–v1.5.2) is removed. LoopLab editor push at the library stack root unchanged.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
